plain: A person who makes a legal claim to something.

webster.text: A person who claims; one who demands any thing as his right.

example.quote: If the claimants have a right to the territories claimed, it is the duty of a good government to provide means to put them in possession of them.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 21, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
